svg.title: Ordinary PCM playback: layers and collaboration
svg.desc: Apps, system audio, HAL implementation, drivers and hardware arranged vertically. FMQ connects system audio and HAL; the device-access backend is inside the HAL implementation. Solid lines carry audio, dashed lines control, and blue dotted lines replies. Nodes and edges are selectable.
svg.text: INSIDE HAL: DEVICE BACKEND AND USERSPACE LIBRARIES
EXAMPLE: ALSA NON-MMAP WRITE · DIRECT DMA · I²S
NOT A UNIVERSAL ANDROID OR QUALCOMM IMPLEMENTATION
NATIVE SERVICES AND ADAPTER · COMPONENT VIEW
FMQ SHARED-MEMORY COMMUNICATION BETWEEN SYSTEM AUDIO AND HAL
GREEN: SAMPLES / SIGNALS. DASHED: SOFTWARE CONFIGURATION.

a.aria-label: Shared track buffer · client writes / server reads
a.text: Shared track buffer · client writes / server reads

a.aria-label: Native AudioTrack — In the same app process
HAL output stream — Read commands/audio; reply
HAL backend / tinyalsa — Here: ALSA userspace access
ASoC card / DAPM — Machine links; route-based power
Playback ring buffer — PCM in memory, not FMQ
DMA / CPU DAI driver — Configure transfer/interface/clocks
DMA engine — Hardware moves memory samples
SoC audio controller — Here: I²S digital interface
Codec / DAC — Digital samples → analog signal
Amplifier → speaker — Drive the load; produce sound
